hero.title: About DEF Tanzania
hero.sub: Disability Enlightenment Foundation (DEF Tanzania) promotes disability rights, inclusion, empowerment, and equal opportunities for persons with disabilities across Tanzania.

intro.title: Who We Are
intro.body: Disability Enlightenment Foundation (DEF Tanzania) is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting disability rights, inclusion, empowerment, and equal opportunities for persons with disabilities in Tanzania. We work toward an inclusive society where people with disabilities can participate fully in education, employment, leadership, entrepreneurship, technology, and community development.

vision.label: Vision Statement
vision.body: A self-reliant and inclusive world where persons with disabilities can participate fully and independently in society.

mission.label: Mission Statement
mission.body: To advance disability rights and inclusion through nationwide public awareness campaigns, community meetings, media engagement, leadership initiatives, awards, and an annual conference for persons with disabilities.

objectives.title: Our Objectives
items: Promote self-reliance, independence, and equal opportunities for persons with disabilities.
Advocate for the rights and dignity of persons with disabilities in Tanzania.
Raise public awareness about the abilities, potential, and contributions of persons with disabilities.
Empower persons with disabilities economically, technologically, socially, and professionally.
Promote leadership development and participation of persons with disabilities in decision-making and public life.

items.name: Inclusion
items.body: Every person deserves to participate fully and have a voice in decisions that affect their lives.

items.name: Equality
items.body: We promote equal rights, equal opportunities, and fair treatment for all.

items.name: Respect and Dignity
items.body: We recognize the dignity, abilities, and individuality of every person.

items.name: Integrity
items.body: We act with honesty, transparency, and responsibility in everything we do.

items.name: Empowerment
items.body: We build skills, confidence, independence, and opportunities rather than dependency.

items.name: Innovation
items.body: We explore accessible and practical solutions to challenges faced by persons with disabilities.

items.name: Collaboration
items.body: We work with communities, government, organizations, and partners to create lasting change.

items.name: Accountability
items.body: We remain responsible to the communities and people we serve.

whoWeServe.title: Who We Serve
whoWeServe.body: We serve children, youth, women, men, and older persons with disabilities, as well as their families, communities, schools, institutions, organizations, and policymakers across Tanzania.
